analysis: Portfolio is already fully deployed and operating on margin (cash = -$16,195). With 4 open positions (APP, MCO, MSFT, V) consuming ~$119K against ~$103K equity, any new BUY would deepen margin exposure — directly contrary to the strategy's risk discipline. Key observations: (1) MSFT is ~48% of equity, well above the 25% hard cap, so concentration risk is already elevated on the largest position. (2) APP is +24.63% and now 25.6% above its SMA50 — technically extended, but the thesis is intact and a trim would be premature without a stop or thesis break. (3) Of the screened candidates, FDS (fwd P/E 12.18, PEG 1.10, 18% of 52w range) and ZBRA (fwd P/E 11.95, PEG 0.54, basing) are genuinely attractive on fundamentals+technicals, but both have earnings within 4-10 weeks, and initiating with negative cash adds unnecessary risk. (4) META (PEG 0.88, 33% rev growth, fwd P/E 17.51) is compelling but in MIXED/SIDEWAYS trend with declining SMA50 slope — not yet confirmed. The correct action is to hold existing positions, allow the thesis to mature, and wait for cash to turn positive before deploying into any new name. Forcing trades with borrowed capital when existing quality positions are working is the single fastest way to undermine compounding. Cash (patience) is the position today.
